notes.title: #Patch 0.1.1.0
notes.content:
[New Content]()
* Added leader board. Compete for the a high score!
* Added post-game stats.
* Added detailed unit information.

[Gameplay]()
* Onslaught map remade and renamed to Mitten Valley.
* Trite and Enforcer stat adjustments. Overall they are tougher, so watch out!

[Cosmetic]()
* Changed enemy tier colors.
* Various Command Card icons updated.

[Optimization]()
* Slight optimized unit scanning behavior.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]#Patch 0.1.0.1[/b]

[Gameplay]()
* All US infantry movement controllers increased.
* Trite tiers health and damage reworked (overall, more health, less damage) and Enforcer tiers health increased.

[Cosmetic]()
* Tier 1 Trites should now animate properly.
* Environmental graphics tweaked for readability.

[Fixes]()
* Difficulty sliders in game menu now working as intended, so good luck!
* Power now displays demand/output.
* Settings: vsync is set to off by default.
* Some auras being duplicated fixed.
* Dozer Trucks now build correctly if you place a blueprint on the Dozer Truck while it's moving.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSsbWHsKb9qQEBy1wMuYBwoUFZdLFkzuQTEJ7-kLs6Gc9XNuXiCNiE31-OnOIBEWcW7KB5ca50qSE8U/pub

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.0
notes.content:
[b]#Patch 0.1.0.0[/b]

[Onslaught]()
Onslaught is a new game mode where you must defend against waves of enemies. Defend against the final wave to win. If your Command Center is destroyed you lose! (You cannot build more Command Centers.) Adjust the settings to tune your experience, but be careful, you can ramp up the difficulty to extremes!

[USA Armor Division]()
A new army has been added! The USA Armored Division utilizes heavy vehicles and heavy weaponry to defeat its enemies. Field utility units to keep your vehicles repaired and continue to smash your enemies.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vRAQbB6-azVE30zfyGD5ILJ_8dHw5rA8m7_pyyUXxrxPE7wxNlxJM_ykidAW3Ia_Ev_t0V1psReNcJd/pub
